findings.title: Mixed custom and HTTP(S) schemes on Activity
findings.description: com.meesho.supply.main.TrampolineActivity registers both a custom URI scheme (@7F12008D) and http/https. An attacker can trigger the http/https handler by crafting a universal link while also exploiting the custom-scheme handler that lacks verification.
findings.remediation: Separate http/https App Links from custom scheme handlers into distinct components. Ensure each uses appropriate verification (autoVerify for App Links, permission for custom).

findings.title: Deep link has no path restriction: https://@7F12008B/*
findings.description: com.meesho.supply.main.TrampolineActivity matches any path under https://@7F12008B/. Without a pathPattern or pathPrefix, the entire URI space under this host is routed into the app, expanding the attack surface for parameter injection and open redirect.
findings.remediation: Add android:pathPrefix or android:pathPattern to restrict which paths trigger this component.

findings.title: Third-party SDK detected: AppsFlyer Attribution
findings.description: AppsFlyer Attribution (TRACKING) is present in the APK. Known data collection: install source, device ID, revenue, in-app events. Third-party SDKs may collect and transmit user data independently of your privacy policy disclosures.
findings.remediation: Enable AppsFlyer privacy mode; implement consent flag.

findings.title: Third-party SDK detected: Facebook SDK (Login/Share)

findings.remediation: Use Facebook's Limited Login; disable automatic event logging.

findings.title: Third-party SDK detected: Google Mobile Ads (AdMob)

findings.title: Third-party SDK detected: Firebase Analytics

findings.title: Dangerous permission requires Data Safety disclosure: RECORD_AUDIO
findings.description: Permission android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO grants access to Audio Files. Under GDPR Article 5, Google Play Data Safety policy, and CCPA, any collection of this data type must be disclosed in your privacy policy and Data Safety section.
findings.remediation: Ensure Audio Files collection is disclosed in your Privacy Policy and Google Play Data Safety section. Only collect what is necessary.

findings.title: Location + network state combination enables device fingerprinting
findings.description: Combining ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION with ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE allows building a highly unique device fingerprint (location + WiFi SSIDs + network topology). This goes beyond normal location access.
findings.remediation: Justify why both permissions are required simultaneously. Avoid persisting or transmitting combined signals.
